cases.name: remeasure-moved-only
cases.record:
meta:
  updated: 2026-09-03
  name: Greenhouse
  scope: Whether the old boiler can hold the greenhouse above 12°C through February
    - the base record, a recipe beside three of its readings, and one hypothesis that
    reads one of them.
sources:
  s.2026_09_02_heating:
    asked: Can we keep the greenhouse above 12°C through February on the old boiler?
    name: 'the heating question, as this session read it: a shortfall in kilowatts,
      not a yes or no'
    of: this session
    read: '2026-09-02'
  doc.boiler_sheet:
    name: the boiler's service sheet
    file: boiler/service-2025.pdf
    read: '2026-09-02'
  run.night_log:
    name: the logger's nightly readings - one line per night below -5°C, counted from
      the file it writes
    of: readings.txt beside this record, read by the recipe the count names
    read: '2026-09-02'
known:
  heat.boiler_kw:
    v: 24
    unit: kW
    name: boiler output
    from: doc.boiler_sheet
    measure: boiler_kw
  heat.loss_kw:
    v: 31
    unit: kW
    name: heat loss on a -5°C night
    from: s.2026_09_02_heating
    at: worked out from the glazing area during the session
    of: '2026-09-02'
    measure: loss_kw
  heat.deficit_kw:
    rule: heat.loss_kw - heat.boiler_kw
    name: shortfall on the coldest night
  log.cold_nights:
    v: 3
    name: nights below -5°C the logger saw
    from: run.night_log
    measure: cold_nights
  when.first_cold_night:
    v: '2027-02-01'
    name: first night that matters
    from: s.2026_09_02_heating
open:
  q.second_boiler: is a second boiler cheaper than glazing the north wall?
judgments:
  c.boiler_short:
    rests_on:
    - heat.boiler_kw
    - heat.loss_kw
    - heat.deficit_kw
    verdict: the old boiler cannot hold 12°C on the coldest February night
    because: It gives {{heat.boiler_kw}} kW against a loss of {{heat.loss_kw}} kW
      - a shortfall of {{heat.deficit_kw}} kW before any wind.
    wrong_if: heat.loss_kw <= heat.boiler_kw
    seen:
      heat.boiler_kw: 24
      heat.loss_kw: 31
      heat.deficit_kw: heat.loss_kw - heat.boiler_kw
  c.short_snap:
    rests_on:
    - log.cold_nights
    - run.night_log
    verdict: the cold snap is short - a bigger boiler is not worth buying for it
    because: The logger saw {{log.cold_nights}} nights below -5°C last winter.
    wrong_if: log.cold_nights > 5
    seen:
      log.cold_nights: 3
      run.night_log: read 2026-09-02
  c.season_plan:
    rests_on:
    - when.first_cold_night
    - log.cold_nights
    verdict: the glazing can wait for January
    because: Nothing matters before {{when.first_cold_night}}, and the snap ran {{log.cold_nights}}
      nights.
    wrong_if: when.first_cold_night < "2027-01-01"
    seen:
      when.first_cold_night: '2027-02-01'
      log.cold_nights: 3
